name: Tooyama Kouji
source:
Yukari's older brother. A serious civil servant.

How he managed to win Kaori over remains a mystery. But he seems to be doing well.

He dotes on Toshiya like a younger brother.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
